stem: Which inference about walking is supported by the information in paragraph 2?

options.label: F
options.text: Skilled athletes can complete their daily walk in a few minutes.

options.label: G
options.text: People have trouble finding time in their day to walk.

options.label: H
options.text: Longer walks may be difficult for beginners to complete.

options.label: J
options.text: Moving at a fast pace makes walking a more enjoyable experience.
